relabeling_covariance.statement: For an adjacency-preserving packet bijection phi, K(phi_*T) is obtained from K(T) by simultaneous row/column relabeling; after deleting phi(r), the reduced matrices are permutation-similar, so their exact determinants and TAU values agree.

proof: Frozen Stage D gives the same factorial-TAU formula on both sides.
The factorial denominators are identical under transpose.
Closed case: endpoint balance gives OUT_T=IN_T at every packet, so all local factorial factors agree.
Open case: OUT-IN=1_s-1_t implies IN(s)=OUT(s)-1, IN(t)=OUT(t)+1, and IN(x)=OUT(x) otherwise; after swapping endpoints/root under transpose, the root/non-root local factorial factors match exactly.
The common positive factorial multiplier cancels, yielding TAU_r(T)=TAU_{r'}(T^T). PE-T01 then converts this to cofactor equality.
reversal_relation.statement: For positive realizable T with endpoints (s,t), det(K_T^(r)) = det(K_{T^T}^{(r')}) where r=t,r'=s in the open case and r=r'=s in the closed case.
